data: Native historical 8-target/4-helper binary typed SBM, two relations, three known prior-family descriptors given to all methods. Historical six parameter support and masses; Gaussian attributes .8*unknown independent feature orientation*label spin + noise sd.6. Original native master function reused by SHA. No true density, signal, hidden role, feature orientation, helper label, or query label enters model inputs.
training: 2048 fresh independent tasks, balanced prior/context/observed-count/coverage schedule. Context indices are label independent. Exactly3 or6 feature-observed nodes. Disjoint coverage samples only outside C; paired-overlap coverage substitutes one observed source with one context node. Raw physical observations are never imputed for factor_pfn. Query sampled-label CE only; same task order and256 successful updates in all arms, last checkpoint, no validation/test selection or extra loss.
method: One latent binary class variable per original node and one latent orientation variable per feature column. Shared graph-conditioned networks create role-conditional graph factors and odd observed-value feature factors. Observed cell (i,f) couples node state and feature state directly, not via a numerical completion. Hard context clamps; finite damped nonbacktracking BP propagates context->graph->feature state->other nodes. Role weights are computed from the same factors' finite-iteration Bethe score, not a separate posterior head. Joint finite BP and score are differentiated through predictive CE. This is a learned conditional structured model with approximate inference; not exact global marginalization or a normalized generative density of continuous X.
scope: Small known-family operator test, not a claim that BP, latent Gaussian orientation, CSBM inference, or graph ICL is novel. Variable feature count is representable by shared column factors, but this pilot trains/tests2 features only; semantic schema and real-graph transfer untested.
test: 96 independent fresh graph seeds,32 per prior. Case schedule matched,matched,density_low,signal_high produces48 matched,24 low-density,24 high-signal graphs. Each graph has contexts1/2/4 x observed-count3/6 x disjoint/paired-overlap =12 episodes. Primary is all query targets in matched disjoint episodes, equally averaged within graph and over fixed seeds. Query-without-features is a prespecified secondary partition.
controls: Actual public GraphPFN Mask Plain and PCFI Plain trained from original public initialization on the identical task schedule and same update/exposure budget. Both receive typed context support and known family. PCFI imputes physical observations before GraphPFN, retains original mask and is actually trained on that input. Known-family Grid6 exact/BP, fixed-mode factor BP, feature-only Gaussian, LP, context-prior and uniform controls. No true-parameter oracle used as a learner. Prior family information is supplied to all methods.
gates: Mechanism gate: factor_pfn - both public Mask and PCFI accuracy paired graph CI lower>0 on primary, plus primary feature removal accuracy CI upper<0. NLL/Brier reported independently. Learned-potential increment requires comparison to fixed-mode factor BP; neither failure nor success is inferred from neural baselines alone. Competitive gate additionally requires Grid6-exact predictive KL<=.01 and>=2x faster same-device forward median than Grid6-BP after all our workers finish. Failure will not trigger rescue tuning.
interventions: Primary matched disjoint context2/observed-count6: no physical observations, shuffle observed values among observed nodes per feature, and structurally permuted graph retaining mask/context/values. Recompute graph-derived public features and PCFI. Do not use query labels. Additional factor-channel-off and feature-to-node-feedback-off are evaluation diagnostics only; never promoted as a selected hybrid.
statistics: 5000 paired base-graph bootstrap resamples after averaging episode/context/observed-count and three fixed training seeds within graph. Primary48 graphs; no node-level pseudoreplication, no training-seed population CI. Secondary OOD/coverage/interventions are not independent confirmation and are not multiplicity adjusted.
validity: Before training: BP marginals and Bethe log partition against enumeration on an acyclic augmented graph, class and feature-sign/permutation equivariance, clamped labels, hidden-value poison invariance, empty-feature behavior, finite predictive gradients through role and conditional branches, no-overlap/observation-budget checks, public forward numerical check. All models and source hashes locked before training. Numerical/preparation corrections allowed only before lock, logged in preflight. No primary/architecture changes after inspecting test results.
